[P2] Reconcile canonical numeric displays with exact expectations

For a service result of `1e4096`, `_display_json()` produces the string `"1e4096"` because the integer exceeds its 4096-digit display limit. An independently declared expectation of `10**4096` has the same fingerprint, but `_same_checkpoint_display()` rejects the string-versus-number comparison, incorrectly failing the matching result. After verifying the fingerprint, compare against the expectation's corresponding display projection while preserving the distinction from an actual JSON string. Add coverage for this out-of-range display case.
